name: schema-violation-data-element-no-type-field
description: A data element that states NEITHER `application_type` nor `implementation_type` — which is also how a data element written before contract `8.0.0`, still saying `type`, reads. Exactly one of the two is required (`rule:interfaces.data_element.type-form`), so the payload is refused when it is bound.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model. The change set creates an interface whose one data element names no type.

authorization.notes: The scope covers every create exactly, so the answer is the engine's and not the authorization boundary's.

input.intent: Carry the synthetic torque on the bus.

value.name: ISyntheticTorque
value.description: The synthetic torque on the bus

expected.notes: The same refusal as `schema-violation-data-element-both-type-fields`, from the other side: one rule, two halves, one address — the element the payload creates.
